title: Exterior styling and outside design
summary: This topic centers on exterior appearance and related outside components, with clear praise for stylish design but many fragments that are too ambiguous or span unrelated issues to classify beyond mentioning the outside of the vehicle.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the G70's exterior styling as beautiful, stylish, sleek, and appealing alongside the interior.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention exterior design, mirrors, trim, a loose outside item, and a gate-access strip, but the examples are too ambiguous or unrelated to summarize as a single clear sentiment.
